overview_description.description:
At StayRelive, we simplify the search and booking process which makes it easy to book Apartments online for short or long stays.

We are an Apartment booking platform connecting travellers with the best accommodation option suitable for Business & Leisure trips by bringing in exceptional & economical Furnished Apartments globally.

Our booking platform with data-driven technology, dynamic global Apartment inventory, and a robust functional product gives facilitators real-time access to consolidate guest, booking, and accommodation data into an insightful live tool enabling clients to search, book & manage bookings with simplicity. 

For the short or long term, we offer you an unequalled choice of professionally managed furnished apartments managed by professionals offering you the best services.
